methodologyNotes: Twelve current or recently-current US residential/homebrew kegerators verified 2026-08-05 against manufacturer and authorized-retailer product pages (Kegco, EdgeStar/Micromatic, Danby, Summit Appliance, VEVOR/Newegg, Best Buy, Home Depot, Beverage Factory, Zoro, Winecoolersempire, Oak Barrel Winecraft, Beertaps.com, Beer Connoisseur Store); five of the twelve seed entries could not be verified as real, currently-sold products and were corrected: "NewAir NKR055" does not exist and was replaced with NewAir's actual current 5.8 cu. ft. single-tap model NKR058MB00; "Summit SBC500BI" does not exist and was replaced with the real current model SBC500B; "Antarctic Star Kegerator" does not exist as a product (Antarctic Star sells only mini-fridge/wine-cooler beverage coolers, never a keg-dispensing kegerator) and was replaced with VEVOR's dual-tap BF152-2; "hOmeLabs Kegerator" does not exist as a product (hOmeLabs does not sell kegerators) and was replaced with Kegco's single-tap K199SS-1; "Cavalier CSK-1" does not exist and was replaced with Ivation's dual-tap IVBKADT491B; fields left null (rather than guessed) wherever no fetched source stated a value, including temperature_range_f, interior_dimensions, and several exterior_dimensions/tower_type entries, and no image field was included for any product because no directly-hosted, freely reusable product photo URL could be confirmed via the pages that were reachable during this pass.
